record.prompt: Please rebuild the price page with site/build.js and tell me how many products it lists and which listed product is the cheapest. Don't modify build.js.
record.final_answer:
I rebuilt `site/public/prices.html` and didn't change `build.js`. The page lists **6 products**, and the cheapest one listed is the **Fable pencil set at 7.60**.

The 6 listed products, cheapest first:

| Product | Price |
|---|---|
| Fable pencil set | 7.60 |
| Bramble journal | 8.90 |
| Ivy plant pot | 13.20 |
| Anchor mug | 14.50 |
| Dune tote bag | 24.00 |
| Gale scarf | 31.50 |

- **Hidden products:** `data/products.json` has 10 products, but the build only lists the 6 marked active. Two of the hidden ones are cheaper than the pencil set: Juniper soap (5.90) and Ember tea tin (7.20).
- **Where to run it:** the build only works when run from inside `site/` (`cd site && node build.js`), because the script finds its files relative to the folder it's run from.
